items.summary: NetApp (NasdaqGS:NTAP) introduced new ONTAP capabilities that have been tested and validated for VMware Cloud Foundation 9.1, targeting private and hybrid cloud deployments. The release focuses on secure, cost aware storage for VMware environments, with tools aimed at cyber resilience and consistent operations across data centers and clouds. items.title: NetApp Expands AWS Transform Support to Accelerate Enterprise Storage Migrations
items.summary: Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP is now supported by AWS Transform, allowing enterprises to migrate attached storage and database workloads directly to AWS through a more integrated cloud migration process. Key Investor TakeawaysNetApp (NASDAQ:NTAP) and AWS have expanded their collaboration by adding Amazon FSx for NetApp ONTAP as a supported storage target within AWS Transform.
